name: aura-tracking
description: Wonder Scanner scan overlay: tracking shade + etching outline + per-wonder aura skin while a detected object is held in the lens. Canvas 2D, mobile 60Hz, 390x844.

phases.note: lock-on brackets converge; shade fades in
etching outline fills with gauge; aura emitter 4->48 particles; ghost trail samples every 80ms
gauge 1: inner light pulses once, outline snaps solid, aura orbit contracts
spotlight darkens outside to 0.4; aura freezes then scatters with the capture punch
aura fades 250ms, pool returned; on target loss instead: dashed afterimage 1500ms

reduced_motion.behavior: remove ghost trail, pulse, orbit contraction and aura emitter; keep static shade, etching outline with corner ticks, progress tag, and a single static 1px aura ring in the skin color
